messageId.description: Gmail message ID. Obtain from list_messages or read_email.

attachmentId.description: Gmail attachment ID from read_email's attachments array. Preferred when available.

filename.description: Attachment filename from read_email's attachments array. Used to resolve the attachment when attachmentId is not provided.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type override. Defaults to the MIME type from the matching message part.

previewPages.description: Number of pages to render as images and return alongside the text (PDF only). Omit or set to 0 to skip. Useful for visually checking signatures, logos, or layout.
